# kihera-pay — generated mirror, do not edit here

Netlify deploys this repo to **pay.kihera-farms.com**. Every file is a
copy synced from **`web/pay/` in `Dii-winga/kihera-app`**, which is the
source of truth. Edits made directly here are overwritten on the next
sync — change the page in kihera-app instead.

This page takes money. A hand-edit here is a change to a payment page
that no test in kihera-app has seen: `supabase/functions/tests/pay_page_test.ts`
runs the shipped script against a stub document and would not know.

See `web/pay/README.md` and `docs/domain/PAYMENTS.md` in kihera-app.
